dedupe_keys.name: uke radio permit lists mobile base stations gsm umts lte 5g radio links tv and radio transmitters in poland monthly open data

description: The President of Poland's Office of Electronic Communications publishes monthly lists of the radio permits it has issued, as open data on the national portal dane.gov.pl. Separate datasets cover the permits for base stations of mobile networks using GSM, UMTS, LTE and 5G NR and stations using CDMA; point-to-point systems (radio links) in the fixed service; point-to-multipoint systems; television stations (analogue and DVB-T/DVB-H) and radio stations in the broadcasting service; the land mobile service; and amateur stations. Each dataset has a zipped list added every month, with 39 files currently listed for the base station set (about 16 MB each, latest 31 August 2026) and the radio link set (about 16 to 21 MB). The lists typically give the permit holder, station location with coordinates, frequencies, antenna heights and other technical parameters. Coverage: Poland. Format and access: monthly ZIP archives on dane.gov.pl, free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the field list and coordinate format were not checked, since files were not opened; the lists show permitted stations, which may differ from those in operation. Simulation uses: building national inventories of mobile sites and microwave backhaul links for hazard exposure and network graphs, and tracking roll-out of 5G month by month. Related records: the SIIS broadband infrastructure archive covers fixed networks, and the Ofcom Wireless Telegraphy Register and ČTÚ licence data are comparable registers.
